findings.title: AC3 says text is "bounded" but the file list has no cap
findings.detail: Design caps the title (120) and detail (200 chars) but gives no limit for `(files: …)`. AC3's test files 20 files and only asserts the headline starts with the marker, so an implementer has no bound to assert. State a cap (e.g. first 5 files plus `+N more`) or say the list is unbounded and only the marker position is guaranteed.

findings.title: Key does not include the filed text's file cap, and lookup is plain substring
findings.detail: The marker lookup is a substring search of `wtfu:<key12>` over the headline text of the ideas file and archive. Say explicitly that it matches on the headline text only (not drawers or bodies) and that a key12 prefix collision is accepted. Also note it adopts ideas filed by an earlier campaign on the same spec (same spec_id/title/files). That seems intended (it prevents duplicates across rework campaigns) but is not stated.

findings.title: Carry persistence on a human-moved campaign is only partly specified
findings.detail: If `finish` finds the campaign moved by a human, the state keys are not copied, so `review_carry` is dropped. The spec accepts this because the review re-runs on resume. It does not say what happens if the human resumes to a state past REVIEWING. Either add a one-line statement or a test that a resume re-merges the carry.

findings.title: Design is dense and several promises have no dedicated test row
findings.detail: The Test plan maps files to ACs only loosely. Items such as the `tick.v1` additive `followups` key, `except Exception` around `close_campaign` setting `res.error = repr(e)`, and epic = parent frontmatter read from the main checkout are covered only inside AC5/AC6/AC3 prose. Add them to the named test files. `add_idea` is an `@org_writer`; confirm it is safe from the worker thread (the spec assumes the serial close step makes it so).

findings.title: Size is at the upper edge
findings.detail: Eight ACs, but they cover carry-over, the filer, profile keys, a new ledger event, reporting and docs. Acceptable for one campaign because they share one code path. If the implementer struggles, carry-over (`_merge_carry`) is the natural split.

findings.title: Non-goals and Clock Log boilerplate
findings.detail: Non-goals are present and substantive. The empty-looking `## Clock Log` section is template boilerplate, not a placeholder, so it is harmless.
